name: Yes1 associated transcriptional regulator
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: YAP1 encodes transcriptional coactivator YAP1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to coloboma, ocular, with or without hearing impairment, cleft lip/palate, and/or impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Thymoma; Ependymoma; Porocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: YAP1 encodes transcriptional coactivator YAP1. Based in part on similarity, the Hippo signaling pathway core involves a kinase cascade featuring STK3/MST2 and STK4/MST1, along with its regulatory partner SAV1, which phosphorylates and activates LATS1/2 in complex with their regulatory protein, MOB1. This activation leads to the phosphorylation and inactivation of the YAP1 oncoprotein and WWTR1/TAZ. The transcriptional regulation of gene expression requires TEAD transcription factors and modulates cell growth, anchorage-independent growth, and induction of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT).

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with coloboma, ocular, with or without hearing impairment, cleft lip/palate, and/or impaired intellectual development (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving YAP1 have been reported in thymoma, ependymoma, and porocarcinoma.
